headline: Nasdaq Plunges Amid AI Infrastructure Scrutiny and Investor Sell-Off
summary: The Nasdaq suffered a sharp single-day decline, eliminating trillions in market value due to investor concerns regarding increased scrutiny on artificial intelligence and data center construction.
why: The Nasdaq index has heavy exposure to technology companies, making it sensitive to regulatory shifts and market sentiment regarding artificial intelligence infrastructure spending.
why_moved: Fears of increased regulatory scrutiny on AI and data center investments triggered a massive sell-off across technology stocks, sharply pulling down the index.
